sens_en: to inhale, to suck, to absorb
origine_fr: La bouche 口 et 及, qui donnait le son mais se lit jí, loin de xī. 吸, c'est faire entrer le souffle. Aspirer, inhaler, absorber.
origine_en: The mouth 口 and 及, which gave the sound but reads jí, far from xī. 吸 is drawing breath in. To inhale, to suck, to absorb.

phrase.fr: Il est interdit de fumer ici.
